summary: Practise Conditional Access, JIT privileged access and identity threat response. Explore case-based labs for cloud and hybrid security teams.
lede: Identity security uses identity context to shape access decisions across cloud and hybrid environments. For cybersecurity engineers, cloud architects, IT operations leads and security managers, the training focuses on assessing and strengthening identity controls through Conditional Access and MFA reviews, privileged-account mapping, just-in-time elevation workflows, SSO configuration checks and identity-alert triage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who configure, assess or govern identity controls across cloud and hybrid environments. It suits experienced practitioners who can relate access policies to their organization's applications, users and operational constraints.
modules: Identity Attack Paths and Control Priorities
prerequisites: Working knowledge of cloud or hybrid identity administration, authentication controls and basic cybersecurity operations is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with the access-management environment relevant to your role; live configuration depends on available Microsoft Entra ID or Okta tenant access.
